label: isDirty reads the saved marker backwards
undo gives the redo step a fresh serial, so redo back to the save reads dirty
find: guard historyIsLive, let step = history.undo.popLast() else { return }
replace:
guard historyIsLive, var step = history.undo.popLast() else { return }
        step.serial = history.newSerial()

label: a New File swap leaves the saved marker on the old document
the cap forgets the dropped step, so undoing to the bottom reads as the save
a save does not end the edit run, so the next nudge merges into the saved step
the close prompt names the wrong file for an unsaved document
